finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I have been known to go on lucky streaks,” the human smiled as he responded casually. “How about you? Do you come to these kinds of establishments often?”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Even the dealer looked surprised, even if they weren’t quite suspicious yet. They trusted their skills and didn’t believe cheating was possible. It shouldn’t be possible, but this man just kept proving himself far too lucky.
